task: Can you show me the page with the filing fee for a self-petitioned I-140 application?
agent_final_answer:
I navigated to the page that shows the filing fee for a self-petitioned I-140 application: the USCIS "G-1055, Fee Schedule" page at https://www.uscis.gov/g-1055.

Path taken: Searched "I-140" -> opened the I-140 form page -> its "Filing Fee" section links to the Fee Schedule page -> on the Fee Schedule page, used the "Select a Form for Fee Information" dropdown and selected "I-140, Immigrant Petition for Alien Workers".

The displayed fee table for the I-140 shows:
- General Filing: $715 (Paper Filing Fee) / $665 (Online Filing Fee), plus additional fees if applicable.
- Additional Fees - Asylum Program Fee:
  a. Regular Petitioner: $600
  b. Nonprofit: $0
  c. Small Employer or self-petitioner: $300

For a self-petitioner, the Asylum Program Fee is $300 (row c), in addition to the General Filing fee ($715 paper / $665 online).
